note: USFS (Nez Perce-Clearwater NF) campground on the main Salmon River ~10 mi east of Riggins on the Salmon River Rd; the main non-motorized boat ramp for this reach. 18 drive-in sites, vault toilets, hand-pump potable water; $10/night. First-come, first-served (no reservations). --Claude

note: USFS campground (Nez Perce-Clearwater NF) along the Red River on Red River Hot Springs Rd #234, ~4 mi east of the closed Red River Ranger Station. Sites with picnic tables and metal fire rings, vault toilets, potable water; first-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov). Large RVs have limited access — larger rigs should preview the site before entering. --Claude
